articles.summary: WYOMISSING, Pa --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 5, 2026-- PENN Entertainment, Inc. (Nasdaq: PENN) announced today that it will release its 2026 third quarter financial results at 7:00 a.m. ET on Thursday, November 5, 2026, followed by a conference call and simultaneous webcast at 9:00 a.m. ET.
articles.title: PENN Entertainment to Report Third Quarter Results and Host Conference Call and Webcast on November 5
